title: Forms, analytics, robots, sitemap and redirects readiness matrix
scope: Non-production verification of forms, provider-neutral analytics, robots policy, sitemap alignment and redirects for PR #8 controlled rebuild.

areas.label: Forms / lead endpoint
assertions: POST /api/leads validates payloads and rejects submissions without explicit privacy consent.
Dry-run is default and makes no external amoCRM/Telegram calls.
Live routing remains disabled until separate owner approval.

areas.label: Analytics contract
assertions: Provider-neutral DOM event contract is present.
Yandex Metrica is recorded as deferred until site publication/domain binding.
Counter ID, cookies and provider script injection remain disabled.

areas.label: robots.txt / indexability policy
assertions: Production robots.txt allows public crawl and declares production sitemap.
Protected staging remains separately noindex through Traefik headers and Basic Auth, not by changing production robots.txt.
Preview/review/thank-you routes are excluded from sitemap checks.

areas.label: Redirects / 404
assertions: Redirect sources are excluded from sitemap.
Static 404 page exists and remains noindex.

blockingProductionDependencies.reason: Allowed end-to-end test leads require live destinations approval; do not execute real submissions yet.
Analytics provider IDs/cookies and consent activation require owner approval.
Real health/lead-failure/no-lead alert destinations require approved monitoring channels.
